protocol.inner_iterations: min(1024, max(1, ceil(8 MiB / file size)))
protocol.strict_win: size <= reference AND encode <=0.90*reference AND decode <=0.90*reference
protocol.source_policy: freeze codec before full corpus performance run; no tuning on holdout results
protocol.scope: User-space page representation, not macOS kernel memory compressor.
